title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Graph of Concept Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2602.03006v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for discriminative workloads is often limited by inference latency, compute, and API costs at scale. Active distillation reduces these costs by querying an LLM oracle to train small discriminative students, but most pipelines distill only final labels, discarding intermediate reasoning signals and offering limited diagnostics of what reasoning is missing and where errors arise. We propose Graph of Concept Predictors (GCP), a reasoning-aware active distillation framework in which the teacher's reasoning is elicited as a directed acyclic graph of intermediate concepts and mirrored in the student. GCP enhances sample efficiency through a graph-aware acquisition strategy that weights per-concept uncertainty, gradient diversity, and coverage by node centrality. translated_title: 将大语言模型推理蒸馏到概念图预测器中
translated_abstract: 在大规模应用中，部署大语言模型（LLM）进行判别式任务往往受到推理延迟、计算成本和API调用成本的制约。主动蒸馏通过查询LLM预言机来训练小型判别式学生模型，从而降低这些成本，但大多数流程仅蒸馏最终标签，丢弃了中间推理信号，且对缺失了哪些推理以及错误在何处产生缺乏诊断能力。我们提出了概念图预测器，这是一个推理感知的主动蒸馏框架，其中教师模型的推理被引导为中间概念的有向无环图，并在学生模型中构建对应的镜像结构。GCP通过一种图感知的采集策略提升样本效率，该策略对每个概念的不确定性、梯度多样性以及基于节点中心性的覆盖率进行加权。此外，它通过执行针对性的子模块再训练来提高训练的稳定性和效率，该机制将下游损失归因于
tldr: 提出了推理感知的主动蒸馏框架GCP，将LLM教师模型的推理过程建模为中间概念的有向无环图并镜像到小型学生模型中，通过图感知的数据采集策略和针对性子模块再训练，显著提升样本效率和训练稳定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes GCP, a reasoning-aware active distillation framework that distills the teacher LLM's reasoning as a directed acyclic graph of intermediate concepts into small student models, improving sample efficiency and training stability via a graph-aware acquisition strategy and targeted sub-module retraining.
